edges: Mount Elbert is the highest peak in the Rocky Mountains, while Mount Massive is the second-highest.
Mount Elbert is the highest point in the U.S. but is the second-highest summit in the contiguous United States after Mount Whitney.
La Plata Peak is the fifth-highest peak in the Rockies, while Mount Elbert is the highest.
There was a dispute over the heights of Mount Elbert and Mount Massive.
Mount Elbert is the fourteenth-highest mountain in the United States when including Alaska and Hawaii.
Anna Elizabeth Dickinson ascended Mount Elbert on a mule borrowed from the U.S. government.
The community of Twin Lakes lies at the base of Mount Elbert.
